source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 1 · lesson 25. Exercises reused from the lesson; du'aas flagged for review.
topic: Bismillah, the right hand, and Alhamdulillah

learn.en: Wash your hands, sit up straight, and say Bismillah before eating or drinking.
learn.title: Before you begin

learn.en: Eat small bites with your right hand and chew slowly. If sharing a plate, eat from your own side.
learn.title: With the right hand

learn.en: Don't blow on food or drink, or breathe into the cup. Sitting to eat is better than standing.
learn.title: At the table

learn.en: Never eat or drink with the left hand, and never talk with your mouth full.
learn.title: Good manners

learn.en: When you finish, praise Allah who gave you food and drink.
learn.title: When you finish
learn.ar: الحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
learn.tr: Al-ḥamdu lillāhi lladhī aṭʿamanā wa saqānā wa jaʿalanā muslimīn

learn.en: “Eat and drink, but do not waste.” (Qur'an 7:31)
learn.title: Don't waste

words.ar: الحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
words.en: After eating: Praise be to Allah who fed us and gave us drink
words.tr: Al-ḥamdu lillāhi lladhī aṭʿamanā wa saqānā wa jaʿalanā muslimīn

quiz.en: Only eat and drink with your ___ hand.
Do not ___ on food or drink.
___ is better than standing while eating.
True or false? Talking with your mouth full is good manners.

think.q: At your next meal, can you remember Bismillah before and Alhamdulillah after?

parents.summary: Eating manners: wash hands, Bismillah, right hand, small bites, no blowing, sit, and the du'aa after eating.
parents.tip: Say the after-meal du'aa together at dinner.
